title: MS-Eval: Benchmarking Sub-Agent Delegation and Orchestration in MCP-Intensive Working Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2610.22869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly integrated into real-world works, yet they must handle diverse domain-specific tools and complex multi-sub-task problems that sequential tool invocation resolves inefficiently and with severe context bloat. The Main-Agent Delegation and Sub-Agent Execution (MAD-SAE) paradigm addresses these issues by delegating sub-tasks to specialized sub-agents for parallel execution in isolated contexts, but its delegation and orchestration quality remains unquantified. translated_title: MS-Eval：面向MCP密集型工作场景的子智能体委派与编排基准测试
translated_abstract: LLM智能体正日益融入真实工作场景，但它们需要处理多样化的领域特定工具和复杂的多子任务问题，而顺序式工具调用在解决这类问题时效率低下，且会造成严重的上下文膨胀。主智能体委派与子智能体执行范式通过将子任务委派给专门的子智能体，在隔离的上下文中并行执行，从而应对这些问题，但其委派与编排的质量尚未得到量化评估。我们提出MS-Eval，这是一个统一的评估套件，包含一个MCP密集型基准测试、一个受控执行框架、专门设计的委派与编排指标，以及用于综合评估的MSQ指数。对四种MAD-SAE变体和八个前沿模型的评估揭示了：（1）子智能体专业化是最佳实践；（2）开源模型在绝大多数情况下具有竞争力，仅存在少数例外；（3）MAD-SAE通常会带来更高的成本……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了MS-Eval——首个针对MCP密集型工作场景下主智能体委派与子智能体执行（MAD-SAE）范式的统一评估套件，包含基准测试、执行框架、委派与编排指标及MSQ综合指数，并发现子智能体专业化是最佳实践、开源模型基本具备与前沿模型竞争的实力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MS-Eval, the first unified evaluation kit for benchmarking sub-agent delegation and orchestration in the MAD-SAE paradigm under MCP-intensive working scenarios, comprising a benchmark, a controlled execution harness, tailored metrics, and an MSQ index, revealing that sub-agent specialization is the best practice and open-source models are largely competitive with frontier models.
